credits.title: Seeds
credits.overview: The coming of age story of a boy that after a traumatic event is taken to beautiful Cuernavaca, where he has to find his father while trying to adapt to life with his grandmother, who has problems of her own.

credits.title: Blue Eyelids
credits.overview: Marina wins a paradise vacation for two, but when she realizes that she has no one to bring along, she decides to invite a stranger named Victor. The pair soon discovers that true love depends more on compatibility rather than idyllic scenery.

credits.title: Los No Invitados
credits.overview: After years of suffering from a sleep disorder, Asunción turns to a specialist who will help her discover the causes of her insomnia.

credits.title: Golpe de suerte
credits.overview: A bureaucrat gets a house and even a car on credit thanks to the support of a compadre who is a union leader, but then has difficulty paying because he is fired in a job cut despite the many years he has been working.

credits.title: Knock Out
credits.overview: Rodrigo Zaracho, once a promising boxer, is in decline. While fleeing from a gang that is chasing him, he remembers his past.
